description: This file contains functions related to firmware upgrading and boot management for Linksys devices within the OpenWrt project. It includes functions to determine the target firmware partition, perform upgrades, and copy configuration backups.

methods.name: linksys_get_target_firmware
methods.description: Determines the current firmware partition used for booting and switches it for the next boot cycle.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade_linksys
methods.description: Performs the firmware upgrade process based on the magic number of the firmware image.

methods.name: platform_copy_config_linksys
methods.description: Copies the backup configuration file to a temporary location.
